Cardiology Clinic Visit Summary
Patient: Thomas Abernathy        Visit date: 11/03/2026
Provider: Michael Lee, MD (Cardiology)
MRN: MHC-552190    DOB: 01/15/1950
Reason for visit: Atrial fibrillation follow-up

ASSESSMENT AND PLAN
Atrial fibrillation with a controlled heart rate. The echocardiogram showed mildly reduced pumping function, so we are adjusting your medicines.

MEDICATION CHANGES
Increase metoprolol succinate from 50 mg to 100 mg once daily.
Start apixaban 5 mg twice a day to lower the risk of stroke.
Stop aspirin 81 mg while you are taking apixaban.
Continue atorvastatin 40 mg at bedtime.

INSTRUCTIONS
Wear the heart monitor for 14 days, then mail it back in the prepaid box.
Check your pulse and blood pressure every morning and keep a log.
Get blood work (CBC and kidney panel) in 2 weeks.
Avoid ibuprofen and naproxen while taking apixaban.

When to Call for Help
Call 911 if you have chest pain, fainting, or sudden weakness on one side of the body.
Call the office if you notice: unusual bruising, blood in your urine or stool, a resting heart rate over 120.

Questions for your next visit:
